newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: New investors to buy SPI Tech convertibles.
newsitem.headline: New investors to buy SPI Tech convertibles.

text.p: A group of new investors, led by stockbrokerage Asian Alliance Investment Corp, has offered to subscribe to 150 million pesos worth of convertible bonds to be issued by SPI Technologies Inc, the company said on Friday.
The software programmer said the interest-free convertible bonds carry a 15-month term and are convertible to common shares at a price of 15.50 per share.
SPI shares closed at 15 pesos on Friday, up 50 centavos from the previous day's close.
"If converted, the new shares will represent about 13.9 percent of the expanded capital of SPI Technologies Inc," SPI said. -- MANILA NEWSROOM (63 2) 841-8938 Fax 817-6267
